claims.observable: The matching note appears and the non-matching note is absent

negative_controls.break: Return every note regardless of the query

claims.observable: An explicit empty state appears when no note matches

negative_controls.break: Render no status when the result list is empty

claims.observable: Pressing slash outside an editable field opens search without inserting a slash
happy_path: Focus the page outside an editable field

negative_controls.break: Insert a slash into the page instead of opening search

negative_controls.break: Return an empty JSON array for a matching query

cleanup: Close the browser or terminal session started by the run
